order_note: No predecessor. SQL 163 adds three SECURITY DEFINER functions and replaces nothing (owner 2026-11-12: "the check did not show for mortgage agent and it says check not linked from checksops. The check should be linked", "notes should show on the mortgage agents side as well", "When sending homeowner link from mortgage desk, error missing_cognito_token. Fix it."; 2026-11-13 "Start the desk fixes"). Each is gated by SQL 124's aws_mortgage_desk_readable_request (the assigned mortgage agent holding mortgage_agent, or the platform owner; the request in_progress or completed with a check; 42501 / 22023 otherwise): aws_mortgage_desk_request_check(uuid) returns the request's check display fields (never routing_number or account_number); aws_mortgage_desk_homeowner_timeline(uuid) returns the claim's homeowner_ledger_events written by the request's tenant, newest 200, with the payload note only; aws_mortgage_desk_homeowner_link(uuid, text) reuses or inserts the homeowner_ledger_tokens row of the homeowner on file (the request's homeowner_email, else the claim's policyholder_email; never a caller-chosen address). EXECUTE checksops and the owner only. The spec prerequisites are the file's own (55000 sql163_prerequisite_missing); the applying login must reach check_intake_items, claims, homeowner_ledger_events, homeowner_ledger_tokens and mortgage_handling_requests as the definer past RLS (definer_can_write_relations; the file refuses otherwise, sql163_definer_cannot_reach). No table, column, policy, table grant, trigger or row changes, so the db-readonly-validate trigger count is not affected. Expected pre-state in both environments: the three functions absent (release sql163 v1: 23d41c1086f3f15412a5d374e056eaaf1bef7f428d81b0ffbdda666a5250de87, releaseStateHash('sql163', {})). The API (mortgage-desk-esign.mjs: the workspace check and timeline, send_tracking_link) and the Desk page ship after this through their own guarded paths; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
